title: डिग्गी - Diggi Construction Subsidy Scheme

benefits_as_displayed.small_and_marginal_farmers: 85% of unit cost or maximum INR 340000, whichever is lower
benefits_as_displayed.other_farmers: 75% of unit cost or maximum INR 300000, whichever is lower

eligibility_summary: Minimum 0.5 hectare irrigated cultivable agricultural land
required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Jan Aadhaar Card
Jamabandi copy not older than six months
application_process: Apply through Raj Kisan Sathi portal or nearby e-Mitra centre
construction_conditions: Construction must begin only after Agriculture Department administrative approval
Physical verification before and after construction
Drip or sprinkler set installation is compulsory
Subsidy is deposited directly into farmer bank account after construction according to prescribed standards
limitations: Portal snapshot does not include a separate government order or notification number
Current financial year validity must be verified at query time
Subsidy and eligibility must be rechecked against current official guidelines
Minimum capacity and construction standards must be preserved exactly
notes: Official Raj Kisan Sathi portal snapshot dated 31 October 2026. Preserve the minimum capacity, subsidy limits and construction conditions accurately. Do not infer additional eligibility conditions.
